Quick summary

TomTom's Traffic Index data for Sao Paulo shows a city-wide average congestion level of 47.3%, with evening peak (6 PM) reaching 83.5% extra travel time — among the world's most congested cities.

Key takeaways

  • Sao Paulo averages 47.3% congestion, meaning a 30-minute trip takes ~44 minutes on average
  • PM peak (6 PM) is worst at 83.5% extra travel time; AM peak (8 AM) is 71.3%
  • December 9, 2025 was the worst day recorded with 85.4% congestion
  • Monthly data from 2025 shows relatively stable congestion year-round (37-50%), with January being the least congested (37.5%)
  • This is a data page from TomTom's live Traffic Index, not an article — it provides raw traffic statistics for the city
